meta.description: Find answers to common questions about Cape Town Safari Tours. Learn about our private tours, booking process, pricing, and more.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

questions.question: What types of tours do you offer?
questions.answer: We offer private safaris, wine tours, coastal adventures, cultural experiences, and fully customized itineraries across South Africa.

questions.question: Are your tours private or group-based?
questions.answer: All our tours are 100% private—just you and your group, with no strangers.

questions.question: How do I book a tour?
questions.answer: You can book directly on our website, via email, or by phone. Our team is happy to assist with custom requests.

questions.question: Can I customize my itinerary?
questions.answer: Absolutely! Every tour is tailored to your interests, pace, and preferences. Let us know your dream trip and we'll make it happen.

questions.question: What is included in the tour price?
questions.answer: Our prices are all-inclusive: private guide, transport, entrance fees, and most meals. Any exclusions will be clearly listed.

questions.question: Are there any hidden fees?
questions.answer: No. We believe in transparent pricing. The price you see is the price you pay.

questions.question: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.answer: We accept credit cards, EFT, and other secure payment options. All payments are processed securely.

questions.question: Is a deposit required?
questions.answer: Full payment is usually required to confirm your booking. For custom or large group tours, a deposit may be arranged.

questions.question: What is your cancellation policy?
questions.answer: Cancellations made 30+ days before the tour receive a full refund. See our Terms of Service for details.

questions.question: What happens if the weather is bad?
questions.answer: We monitor conditions closely and will adjust the itinerary for your safety and enjoyment. Alternative activities or rescheduling may be offered.

questions.question: Are your guides certified?
questions.answer: Yes. All guides are experienced, certified, and passionate local experts.

questions.question: Is travel insurance required?
questions.answer: We strongly recommend comprehensive travel insurance for all guests.

questions.question: Can you accommodate dietary restrictions?
questions.answer: Yes, please let us know your dietary needs in advance and we'll ensure you're well taken care of.

questions.question: Do you offer airport transfers?
questions.answer: Yes, private airport transfers can be arranged as part of your tour package.

questions.question: Are your vehicles safe and comfortable?
questions.answer: Our fleet is modern, air-conditioned, and meticulously maintained for your comfort and safety.

questions.question: Is the company eco-friendly?
questions.answer: We are committed to sustainable tourism and support certified eco-friendly partners and local communities.

questions.question: Can I book last-minute?
questions.answer: We do our best to accommodate last-minute bookings, subject to availability. Contact us for urgent requests.

questions.question: How do I contact you in an emergency?
questions.answer: You'll receive a 24/7 emergency contact number with your booking confirmation.

questions.question: Do you offer tours for families with children?
questions.answer: Yes! We welcome families and can tailor activities for all ages.

questions.question: What languages do your guides speak?
questions.answer: Our guides speak English and several other languages. Let us know your preference when booking.

questions.question: Can you help with special occasions (honeymoons, birthdays)?
questions.answer: Absolutely! We love making your special moments unforgettable—just let us know your plans.

questions.question: How far in advance should I book?
questions.answer: We recommend booking as early as possible, especially for peak seasons, but we're happy to help with short notice too.
